descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-02 Patient List Capture · S19 「扫描时间，以及哪个 AI 读的照片」 Scan time and which AI read the photo

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U10 Each scan records which AI model read the photo, and logs the AI call time separately from the total (3.9, 3.5).（UAT 3.9；UAT 3.5）
  • T3 Photo and census scanning runs on Google Gemini Flash via Vertex AI.（TFA-94425 AC 1）

测试设计方法：性能（performance） — 量时间，看是不是在要求的秒数里。

Given The 10 photos of S06 (5 Hospital + 5 Nursing Home)

When Each is scanned once through scanCensusSheet

Then Every call leaves an aiCallLog row with the model, durationMs and providerMs. The recorded model is a Gemini Flash model on Vertex, not a placeholder. Calls over 30 s are listed for review

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Per call, record the aiCallLog row (model, durationMs, providerMs), the ai_disclosure audit row's disclosed_to, and aiProvider:_current visionProvider / visionModel (read only). If model == 'vertex-configured-model', that is a U10 Fail ('model not recorded'): lib/phi.ts writes that literal when the aiProvider row has no visionModel. …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 PERF · 性能计时；矩阵里排的车道 AI 检查（automated）

S19 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-02.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：PERF · 性能计时；辅助：CONFIG · 配置核对 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
